executive_finding: The 52-page FSSAI Metals and Minerals 2024 PDF is attached to an official 26 June 2024 stakeholder-consultation notice, expressly seeking comments BEFORE finalisation. The separate 61-page FSSAI-hosted Trace Elements PDF has different numbering. No subsequent finalisation/adoption/supersession order was directly established; no finished-product method approval follows.

primary_source_chain.exact_key_meaning: Official FSSAI Quality Assurance Division letter invites public comments on Metals and Minerals manual, requests views before its finalisation.
primary_source_chain.regulatory_implication: Panel approval and stakeholder consultation do not alone establish an adopted and compulsory method manual; need evidence of subsequent finalisation/adoption.

primary_source_chain.exact_key_meaning: FSSAI notifications classifies the June 26 item under 'notice-for-comments' and lists Metals and Minerals as an attachment.
primary_source_chain.regulatory_implication: The attachment's documented publication route was consultation, not a final method adoption order.

primary_source_chain.exact_key_meaning: 52-page manual's index assigns FSSAI 09.001:2024 to ICP-OES and 09.003:2024 to ICP-MS for water.
primary_source_chain.regulatory_implication: The numbering is exact in the consultation attachment, but no source evidence establishes eventual mandatory status.

primary_source_chain.exact_key_meaning: Separately hosted 61-page Trace Elements source assigns FSSAI 09.001:2024 to AAS and 09.003:2024 to ICP-AES in food, and expressly notes lab verification responsibility.
primary_source_chain.regulatory_implication: Its source/file differs from the 52-page consultation attachment; FSSAI hosting and lab verification note alone cannot prove supersession/compulsory status.

primary_source_chain.exact_key_meaning: FSSAI maintains a Manuals list and a separate 'Orders for Adopting Above Manuals/Methods by Food Laboratory, Mandatorily' section.
primary_source_chain.regulatory_implication: Seek a specific final/manual-adoption order addressing these metals method IDs; none directly verified in this research batch.

closure_evidence_requirements.needed: Signed notification/order/publication expressly finalising, withdrawing or replacing the June 2024 52-page consultation Metals & Minerals manual; stable final file title, version and method numbering.
Identify currently applicable Manual on Metals / Trace Elements official URL as linked from current FSSAI methods index, original file hash/version, and whether FSSAI 09.001:2024 is AAS or ICP-OES.

For each commercial sample, supply named manual, original PDF URL, full method title and revision/date, instrument technique, targeted analyte(s), sample matrix and validated reporting-basis LOQ; never select solely by 09.xxx number.
Obtain signed laboratory accreditation scope and matrix/analyte-specific in-house verification, quantitative LOQ, recovery and uncertainty; no source note implies a specific lot passed.
Separately confirm exact finished food product/CTR article and effective amendments before comparing any measured analyte with a numeric regulatory limit.

Check any source after 26 June 2024 explicitly finalising the 52-page manual and superseding/naming 61-page Trace Elements methods. Absence from reviewed sources does not prove the document never existed.

csv_export_amendment.scope: All 140 documentary requests; 35 laboratory-method stream rows carry explicit legal/provenance caveat.
csv_export_amendment.proposed_lab_method_disclaimer: IMPORTANT PRIMARY FSSAI NOTICE: The 52-page Metals & Minerals manual was attached to the 26 June 2024 public-comment notice and labelled 'before finalisation'. Its later adoption has not been established. A separate 61-page Trace Elements source uses incompatible 09.xxx:2024 numbering. Do NOT cite a method number alone. Require finalisation/adoption source, full manual title and method name, analyte/matrix-validated accredited lab scope, LOQ and legal CTR article.

controls: Scientific Panel approval is not identical to final mandatory adoption.
An official-hosted consultation PDF is not automatically current binding method guidance.
The separate Trace Elements PDF also requires a specific current adoption/reference check; do not automatically approve it based on its 61-page existence.
Do not convert tentative published method capabilities into a laboratory's validated LOQ.
Do not use any of this method-provenance research to sign legal CTR applicability, lab testing, or product compliance.
